name: Praneet R.S
about_code: """Builds AI systems end-to-end: model -> API -> product."""
"Turn research-grade ML into products people actually use."

points: Architected a reusable multi-agent orchestration engine with CrewAI and n8n that automates an end-to-end production workflow.
Built RAP, a recruitment automation platform where 9 AI agents read job posts, find candidates and rank them into a shortlist.
Automated the recruiter pipeline from shortlist to interview to placement, verified by 111 automated tests.
Benchmarked energy-based anomaly detection against statistical thresholding baselines on time-series sleep data, across accuracy and false-positive rate.
Profiled and optimized the NumPy inference pipeline, cutting latency by 30%, validated on held-out subject data.

community.note: Grew a student tech club to 200+ members; run hackathons, coding workshops and hands-on AI/ML sessions.
Taught basic computer literacy to differently-abled children and supported inclusion campaigns.
